item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"copied_token_count","expression":"(len(request.prompt_token_ids) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0) + len(request.output_token_ids)","rationale":"Tracks list-to-array conversion and copying for prompt and output token IDs."},{"name":"block_count","expression":"sum(len(block_ids) for block_ids in request.block_ids)","rationale":"Tracks block IDs copied when adding the request's block-table row."},{"name":"random_sampling","expression":"int(request.sampling_params is not None and request.sampling_params.temperature != 0.0)","rationale":"Distinguishes the random sampling path, which also enables top-k and top-p bookkeeping in this workload."},{"name":"penalty_count","expression":"(int(request.sampling_params.frequency_penalty != 0.0) + int(request.sampling_params.presence_penalty != 0.0) + int(request.sampling_params.repetition_penalty != 1.0)) if request.sampling_params is not None else 0","rationale":"Counts conditional penalty-set insertions."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is primarily a fixed request-registration cost plus token and block copying, with additional costs from random sampling and penalty bookkeeping."}
